comment: FOAM additions to the CSS inside a css: block. foam-js.tmLanguage.json hands the block to source.css as region meta.foam.css-block.js; this grammar is injected into that region, so it also reaches selectors source.css has already opened (`.x <<y`, `:not(<<y)`). FOAM-only CSS syntax belongs here, in one place.

self-class-selector.comment: FOAM's own-class shorthand. foam.u2.CSS expandCSS rewrites `<<` (and the older `^`) to the class's CSS class, so `<<title` in foam.u2.ActionView means `.foam-u2-ActionView-title`; the suffix takes the characters expandCSS joins with a dash (letters, digits, `-`, `_`). source.css has no rule for either, so without this the token stays plain and a selector it starts (`<<x:hover`) is never opened. The `^` of `[class^=x]` is excluded by the injection selector. The region ends where source.css ends a selector.
self-class-selector.name: meta.selector.css
